data.name: NotRepresentable
data.value: The text cannot be written in {0}, the file's encoding: line {1} has '{2}'.
data.comment: {0} is the encoding's name, {1} the 1-based line, {2} the character.

data.name: NotLossless
data.value: The file is not valid {0}: editing it would write a replacement character for each byte that does not decode.

data.name: ResourceOperation
data.value: Creating a file is not supported; the edit is not applied.

data.name: Folder
data.value: '{0}' is a folder: deleting a folder is not supported; the edit is not applied.

data.name: Exists
data.value: '{0}' exists already: the edit does not rename '{1}' over it, and is not applied.
data.comment: {0} is the path a file is renamed to, {1} the file's path.

data.name: NotRenamed
data.comment: {0} is the file's path, {1} the path it is renamed to, {2} why.

data.name: Stale
data.value: '{0}' changed after the edit was made; the edit is not applied.

data.name: EditDoesNotFit
data.value: The edit of '{0}' does not fit its text: {1}

data.name: Undone
data.value: What the edit had done is undone.
data.comment: Follows the reason an edit failed, when every change made before it was put back.

data.name: NotUndone
data.value: What the edit had done is undone, except in these files, which could not be put back as they were: {0}
data.comment: Follows the reason an edit failed. {0} is the list of the files' paths.
